depth_justification: The copilot has collapsed into a degenerate loop, repeating a near-identical paragraph fixated on a single invented '[P2.D3]/[P2.D4] named-doctor booking' issue while ignoring every substantive detail the developer provided (10/20-year retention under Art. 17(3)(b), Google Cloud Translate PHI leakage, dropped-call clinical-safety gap, missing DPIA/DPO, undocumented contraindication protocol).
